remesh._note_run8: zone_leg_below_m 0.22 relabelled 3,070 hip-zone verts as leg: the crotch shells then sat 'between legs', the voxel fell to its minimum and decimation stalled (LOD0 10k). Both run-8 rules are disabled (99) = run-7 behaviour.

weights_rules._note_run12: Explicit region rules (runs 10-12) scored worse than run 9's heat + zone-hop blend + ring smoothing: clips under 2.5x LOD0 1/32, LOD1 15/32 (run 9: 3/32, 27/32). Kept for the record, off by default. Remaining edges: hip band seam (hips|upperleg vs upperleg|lowerleg at z 0.57-0.67), crotch/apron centre, arm zone edge at the shoulder band.

weights_transfer._doc: robust_weight_transfer.py (Abdrashitov et al. 2023). template = a well-skinned character on the same skeleton; thresholds = the paper's defaults (dist_frac x bbox diagonal, angle_deg). shell_pass overrides for pass 2 (body -> clothing shells). pydeps: scipy + robust-laplacian installed with Blender's Python (README).
weights_transfer._doc_mask: region_mask: the run-9 region limits (allowed_for, grown by remesh.allowed_rings) applied to the MATCHED values only, before the inpaint; mask_result false (a hard mask on the result left weight cliffs, run v3-3: LOD0 Walk 10.1x).
weights_transfer._note_tuning: v3 runs (LOD0 gameplay worst edge): paper defaults + smooth 10 = 3.18x; smooth 30 = 2.88x; smooth 60 = 4.06x (arm weight smoothed onto the torso side); normal smoothing 6 (30% matched instead of 21%) = 5.38x; result-masking = 10.2x. LOD1 is best from the 10-iteration weights (worst 2.37x vs 3.24x from the 30-iteration ones).
